summary.text: Rick West is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 3 since November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the same seat from 2016 to 2018, advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026, and lists his profession as farmer and rancher.

paragraphs.text: Rick West lives in Heavener, Oklahoma, and his career experience includes working as a poultry farmer, cattle rancher and animal inspector for the U.S. Department of Agriculture.
West previously held the District 3 seat from 2016 to 2018 and returned to office on November 18, 2020, succeeding Lundy Kiger.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Energy and Natural Resources Oversight Committee, and in 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Agriculture & Rural Development Committee.
